[issue by RedyRT]
### Bug Description

Are we still be ignoring that fact this bug still exist? #3098 #3364 I even tested with my friend this, and on friend PC its the same bug that i mention and also i have only 1 sodium mod installed, with modpack there somehow will be really multiple pixels on screen and it gets really annoying with this... i know you'll say on 1.21.11 its fixed but not that many people plays on this version really... is there any chance this graphic bug will be fixed? Because i just checked very first version of sodium on this minecraft version mc1.21-0.6.0-beta.1-neoforge, and this version doesnt even have this bug, but subsequent versions of this mod starting to have this bug

### Reproduction Steps

1. Minecraft 1.21.1 Neoforge Build 21.1.238
2. Sodium 0.8.12 Release
3. Create a world
4. Make yourself on fire in dark place [because you can see this bug pixel good in dark places]
5. Then you will see 1 or multiple tiny "fire pixels" on your screen
